No FASTag? Why does a ₹1,000 toll cost you ₹1,250?

Since 10 Apr 2026, national-highway toll plazas take no cash: FASTag or UPI only.
Pay by UPI without a valid FASTag and you're charged 1.25× the toll.
Illustrative: ₹1,000 of tolls on a trip home = ₹1,250. Recharge or fix your tag before you drive.

Has a toll plaza ever charged you extra?

Sources: a business news site's 11 Apr 2026 report on the cashless toll rules; a business news site's report on how tolls are paid from 10 Apr. Illustrative maths only.
